verdict.rationale: Poke's docs describe a browsable directory at poke.com/recipes listing first-party and approved third-party recipes, with prebuilt connectors such as Linear and Webflow. Integrations can be connected, refreshed and disconnected, and any MCP server can be added directly via the CLI when a service isn't in the directory. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the directory, and detail on browsing features (search, categories) and the step-by-step add flow.
